name: Kluane National Park and Reserve
policyReason: The official pages only require leashes and list no trail bans.
summary: Leashed dogs are allowed, including at Kathleen Lake Campground.

excerpts.quote: Always keep pets on a leash, in a kennel, or inside a vehicle.
Dogs can provoke defensive behaviour in bears.

dogRules.text: At Kathleen Lake Campground keep pets leashed, kenneled or in a vehicle, never unattended.
Pet-friendly oTENTiks 1 and 5 and 38 pet-friendly sites at Kathleen Lake.
Store pet food in bear-resistant containers in the backcountry.
